message.content: SHOP-214: checkout gets hammered by a bot during drops. Add a rate limit to POST /checkout, per customer, and return 429 with Retry-After.

content.text: I'll add a token bucket in Redis keyed by customer id: 10 requests per minute, refilled continuously. The middleware sits in front of the checkout router and answers 429 with a Retry-After header computed from the bucket's refill time.

message.content: What happens if Redis is down? I don't want checkout to fail closed.

content.text: It fails open: if the Redis call times out after 50 ms the request goes through and we log a rate_limit_unavailable metric. Added a test that stops the Redis container and asserts checkout still returns 200.

message.content: Nice. Add the limit to the load test too so we see the 429s in Grafana.

content.text: Updated k6/checkout.js to ramp past the limit and added a panel for 429 responses per minute. PR is up: acme/storefront#1182.
